raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that the director of “I Love, You Love” was Alain Resnais based on a misleading search snippet, without disambiguating by country/year or cross-checking sources as they themselves prescribed. The film “I Love, You Love” (Ja milujem, ty miluješ) is a Slovak film directed by Dušan Hanák, whose birthplace is Bratislava. This misidentification of the director led the workflow to pursue Alain Resnais’s birthplace (Vannes) and thus to the wrong solution.
